```sql
SELECT d.batter,
       SUM(d.batter_runs) AS total_runs,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.extras_type IS NULL OR d.extras_type NOT IN ('wide','no_ball')) AS balls_faced,
       (SUM(d.batter_runs)::numeric * 100) /
         NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.extras_type IS NULL OR d.extras_type NOT IN ('wide','no_ball')), 0) AS strike_rate
FROM deliveries d
JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = 2023
GROUP BY d.batter
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
```
